name: DB2 Exec Query - Long Timeout (All Rows)

assignments.name: sql_statement
assignments.value: ={{ $json.sql_statement || "SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(j.submitted_on,'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')-INTERVAL'4'HOUR,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS job_date,ucm.client_id,cm.client_name,cm.erp_account_id AS Salesforce_id,j.user_id,j.widget_id,CASE WHEN j.widget_id=1001 THEN 'Map Theme' WHEN j.widget_id<0 THEN 'Custom Report' ELSE COALESCE(swm.widget_name,(SELECT MAX(r.title) FROM smsadmin.report_template r WHERE r.report_id=j.widget_id)) END AS widget_name,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(j.end_time,'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')-INTERVAL'4'HOUR,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS completed,j.status,ss.status_desc,COUNT(*) AS job_count,cm.web_flag AS ws_user,ucm.is_test_user AS test_user FROM smsadmin.sms_job_details j LEFT JOIN smsadmin.sms_user_info sui ON j.user_id=sui.user_id JOIN smsadmin.user_client_mapping ucm ON j.user_id=ucm.user_id JOIN smsadmin.client_master cm ON ucm.client_id=cm.client_id LEFT JOIN smsadmin.sms_widget_menu swm ON j.widget_id=swm.widget_id JOIN smsadmin.sms_status ss ON j.status=ss.status WHERE TO_DATE(j.submitted_on,'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')-INTERVAL'4'HOUR>=CURRENT_DATE-INTERVAL'7 days' AND TO_DATE(j.submitted_on,'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')-INTERVAL'4'HOUR<CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(j.submitted_on,'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')-INTERVAL'4'HOUR,'YYYY-MM-DD'),ucm.client_id,cm.client_name,cm.erp_account_id,j.user_id,j.widget_id,swm.widget_name,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(j.end_time,'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')-INTERVAL'4'HOUR,'YYYY-MM-DD'),j.status,ss.status_desc,cm.web_flag,ucm.is_test_user ORDER BY job_date" }}
